entities.name: Reporting configuration addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure for adding or modifying measurement reporting configurations in the UE based on received configuration lists.

entities.name: reportConfigToAddModList
entities.description: List containing reporting configurations to be added or modified.

entities.name: reportConfigId
entities.description: Identifier for a specific reporting configuration.

entities.name: reportConfigList
entities.description: List of configured reporting configurations stored in VarMeasConfig.

entities.name: measIdList
entities.description: List of measurement identifiers stored in VarMeasConfig.

entities.name: VarMeasReportList
entities.description: List containing active measurement reporting entries.

entities.name: periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer used for periodic measurement reporting.

entities.name: timer T321
entities.description: Timer T321 used in measurement reporting procedures.

entities.name: timer T322
entities.description: Timer T322 used in measurement reporting procedures.

entities.name: VarMeasConfig
entities.description: Variable containing the UE's measurement configuration.

entities.name: entry with matching reportConfigId exists
entities.description: Condition checking if a reporting configuration with the given ID already exists in the configuration list.

entities.name: reconfigure the entry
entities.description: Action to update an existing reporting configuration with new values.

entities.name: remove measurement reporting entry
entities.description: Action to remove a measurement reporting entry from the reporting list.

entities.name: stop and reset timers
entities.description: Action to stop running timers and reset associated measurement information.

entities.name: add new entry to reportConfigList
entities.description: Action to add a new reporting configuration to the configuration list.

relations.description: The procedure uses the reportConfigToAddModList to determine which configurations to add or modify.
The procedure checks if an entry with matching reportConfigId exists before reconfiguration.
If an existing entry is found, it is reconfigured with the received values.
For each measId associated with the reportConfigId, remove the reporting entry from VarMeasReportList.
For each measId associated with the reportConfigId, stop running timers and reset associated information.
Stops the periodical reporting timer if running.
The procedure adds a new entry for the received reportConfig to the reportConfigList.
reportConfigId is used to identify entries within the reportConfigList.
measId is used to identify entries within the measIdList.
